event: Day 40: Wren walks the perimeter at dawn, not surveying, just walking.
Theron's trowel sounds from the eastern channel; Brecca breathes at the wall; Hadley sorts food.
Four people's morning is spread across a space built for dozens.
The Vael runs beneath everything; this dawn's vibration carried it start to finish.
The ghost-elms' hum has a new depth she could not have named a week ago.
At the northern edge by the escarpment trail she lets the bond's awareness extend.
The triad's chord runs through her, the Vael beneath it in the bedrock.
She follows the limestone like a root, slowly, along the substrate's contour.
She reaches the Warden's Eye, its slow pulse-rhythm clearer than ever.
The Eye is carrying the Vael, receiving the land's voice through continuous bedrock.
A discovery logs Vael propagation to the Eye at 3-4 miles: +50 XP, 2261 / 2573.

changes.note: Discovery: bond-at-distance, Vael propagation to the Eye

event: She feels the network's reach: the triad behind, the Eye ahead, the Vael beneath.
After lunch Brecca walks to the threshold stone unprompted.
Wren follows twenty meters back, close enough to see, not to intrude.
Brecca looks at the stone like a door she is not sure she should open.
Brecca puts her palm on the east face and her whole body locks rigid.
She does not pull away; Wren counts past a minute of shallow, bearing breath.
Her jaw loosens and her fingers settle in, the way they settle into a joint.
'Four thousand years. This is not heavy. This is deep. Further than anything human.'
Wren says the threshold stone sits directly on the bedrock.
The builders did not maintain this stone, they devoted it: the intention is saturated.
'Can you feel the seventh band?' After a long silence: 'Yes.'
The seventh band was pressed the way she presses, but with a permanence she lacks.
'The stone did not resist. It received, as if waiting for that quality of hand.'
Wren lays Detail Notation beside her hand; with the Vael and Stone Listening it is her richest read.
The seventh band's reinforcement is directional: it points south, to Hearthstone.
Hearthstone's central foundation has the same 'intention that exceeds construction.'
'The builders were connected. Not the same hands. The same quality of hands, taught.'
Brecca keeps her palm on the stone another minute, then studies her calluses.
'I am at the beginning. They were at the end of something I have not started yet.'
Beneath her palm the Vael sings.
Wren kneels at the western planting site; three days in, nothing shows.
[Keen Survey] shows the pod shells softening at the base.
The first root extends outward along the limestone grain, not downward.
The substrate receives the seeds without surprise; it held ghost-elm roots for centuries.
A discovery logs ghost-elm pre-germination activity: +30 XP, 2291 / 2573.
She finds Theron at the retreated strip's southern edge where the dressed stone vanishes.
The corruption's edge cuts straight across the channel like a ruler.
The grey soil grips the buried blocks like a fist: no air, no water, no passage.
He points out a block's corner under the grey: 'The corruption stopped it.'
South, the trees grow too symmetrically and the soil holds its silence.
'Fourteen days to the next pulse.' 'Fourteen.' Day 54 minus Day 40.
Another degree or two of retreat and he can clear five more meters, maybe the next junction.
'My job is to make sure the water has somewhere to go when it returns.'
At the evening fire Wren journals the Eye, Brecca's seventh band and the seedpods.
She writes that Theron reached the boundary and will be ready.
Hadley sketches insect counts mapped to the shimmer's edge in his own journal.
Brecca sits palms-flat at the wall; Theron turns the counting rod, still learning it.
The Hearthstone marks from Day 27 expire around Day 57, three days after the pulse.
Going back would save the comparison data but leave the settlement two days before the pulse.
She does not decide tonight; fourteen days to the third pulse.
She closes the journal while the Vael sings and four people hold steady.
